name: Mutual Non-Disclosure Agreement
description: Champions Group Mutual NDA Master Template v1. Post-discovery services exploration where no records or data move. If data moves in either direction, send the Database NDA as well (deferred to phase 2).

fields.label: Counterparty registered legal name
fields.help: The registered entity, never a trading name. Trading names cannot hold rights or be sued.

fields.label: Counterparty CIN / company number
fields.help: Leave blank only if the counterparty cannot supply it; it will render as a confirm marker.

fields.label: Purpose of disclosure
fields.placeholder: Evaluating a potential engagement under which Champions would provide B2B data and demand generation services to the Counterparty.
fields.help: One or two sentences. Must match the client note exactly (product names, dates).

fields.label: Non-circumvention (24 months)
fields.help: Keep on wherever the purpose involves referrals, introductions, revenue share, brokers or capital sourcing. Never disclaim it against a vendor touching lead flow.

schedule_defaults.survival: 3 years from termination; Trade Secrets and Personal Data: perpetual
schedule_defaults.sample_deletion: 15 days from request or the end of the evaluation, whichever is earlier
